description: Get assets representing spoke tokens on the hub (Sonic) chain, optionally filtered by source chain

chainId.description: Filter by source spoke chain key, name or EVM chain id (e.g. 'sonic', 'ethereum', 'Base', '8453'). Call sodax_get_supported_chains for the full, live list.

format.description: Response format: 'json' for raw data or 'markdown' for formatted text

name: sodax_get_hub_assets
